rows.jp: 友貴がいるかと思ったが、無人だった。
rows.en: I thought Tomoki might be there, but it was empty.

ghs.en: I was wondering whether Tomoki was here, but it was deserted.

rows.jp: きっと『部活』に精を出しているのだろう。
rows.en: He was probably hard at work on his “club activity.”

ghs.en: He's working hard at his 'club', I'm sure.

rows.jp: となれば、今頃は町中か。
rows.en: Which meant he was somewhere out in town by now.

ghs.en: And if he is, right now he'd be downtown.

rows.jp: ノートによれば、この世界は一週間しか続かないのだから、ヤツの努力は無駄なものになる。
rows.en: According to the notebook, this world would last only one week, so all his effort would come to nothing.

ghs.en: According to the notebooks, this world will last for just one week, therefore, all the efforts that guy makes will go to waste.

rows.jp: けど、それを教える気にはなれなかった。
rows.en: But I couldn't bring myself to tell him.

ghs.en: But I could not bring myself to tell him that.

rows.jp: 友貴の部活が、先輩にとっての部活と、意味を違えるとは思えなかったからだ。
rows.en: Because I couldn't see any difference between what club activity meant to Tomoki and what it meant to Mimi.

ghs.en: Because it didn't seem that Tomoki's club had a different meaning for him than Senpai's had for hers.
